patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I think my contact lens tore and scratched my eye. It feels like there's sand in it, it's watering like crazy and the light hurts, but I can still see fine.
clinical.presentationShort: 27yo F — foreign-body sensation, tearing, photophobia after contact-lens trauma, vision intact — corneal abrasion.
clinical.presentationLong: 27-year-old female with foreign-body sensation, tearing, and photophobia after contact-lens trauma, with intact visual acuity — corneal abrasion.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → fluorescein exam, remove any FB, topical antibiotic, NO steroids, ophtho if not healing; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Fluorescein confirms the abrasion. Antibiotic drops, no patch for contact wearers, no steroids.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, dabbing one watering eye with a tissue
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 27-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: dabbing one watering eye with a tissue, squinting. Expression: uncomfortable, squinting against light. Clearly visible: one red, watering, squinted eye. No text, no logos.
